title: Glimpses of Workshop on SAVE BIRDS through ECO ROOTS FOUNDATION, New Delhi held on 29th April 2022 at IPC, Campus.
bodyHtml: Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission has organized a Workshop on SAVE BIRDS through ECO ROOTS FOUNDATION, New Delhi on 29th April 2022 at IPC, Campus. The Theme of the Workshop was to save the environment . Mr. Rakesh Khatri, Founder of ECO ROOTS FOUNDATION also known as the " The Nest Man of India" he and his team has taught the necessity to influence the future of the world and encourages youth to take care for their environment. During this workshop more than 60 employees of IPC participated and enjoyed learning how to make nests for birds and placed those nests at IPC campus.
